checks.name: csv_headers_match_dictionary
checks.description: CSV header == data-dictionary column list (names and order)

checks.name: required_fields_present
checks.description: Every field marked R in the dictionary is non-empty

checks.name: types_parse
checks.description: int / real / bool(0,1) / date / datetime values parse

checks.name: allowed_enums
checks.description: Enumerated fields contain only allowed values

checks.name: numeric_ranges
checks.description: Numeric fields lie inside the documented RANGE

checks.name: id_and_format_patterns
checks.description: PATTERN constraints (ID conventions, e-mail format) hold

checks.name: text_lengths
checks.description: Text fields respect the documented LEN bounds

checks.name: primary_key_uniqueness
checks.description: Primary keys are unique (single and composite)

checks.name: unique_constraints
checks.description: UNIQUE fields / composite unique sets contain no duplicates

checks.name: foreign_key_integrity
checks.description: Every FK value exists in its parent table (join validation)

checks.name: term_dates_ordered
checks.description: registration_opens < start_date < end_date; add/drop and aid deadlines inside the term

checks.name: policy_windows
checks.description: policy effective_from <= effective_to; superseded policies have an end date; status matches as-of date

checks.name: article_version_chain
checks.description: Versions per topic are gap-free (1..k), windows contiguous & non-overlapping, only the last is open-ended, status matches as-of date, window lies inside the source policy window

checks.name: person_active_windows
checks.description: requester/staff active_from <= active_to; requester.status consistent with active_to

checks.name: ticket_dates
checks.description: created_at <= updated_at; deadline >= created date; requester active at creation; term window covers creation

checks.name: message_order
checks.description: Message seq_no contiguous 1..n, created_at non-decreasing, first message = ticket body at created_at, none before ticket

checks.name: event_order
checks.description: Event seq_no contiguous, event_at non-decreasing and >= ticket.created_at

checks.name: assignment_windows
checks.description: assigned_at <= unassigned_at; assigned_at >= ticket creation; consecutive assignments do not overlap

checks.name: sla_times
checks.description: sla.clock_start = ticket.created_at; due >= start; response / resolution >= start

checks.name: feedback_times
checks.description: resolved_at >= created_at; feedback_at >= resolved_at

checks.name: event_chain_and_transitions
checks.description: First event is 'created'; each from_status = previous to_status; every transition is in the allowed table

checks.name: ticket_state_matches_history
checks.description: ticket.status = last event.to_status; updated_at = last event_at; category = last (re)categorisation; current_team = last assignment

checks.name: closed_after_resolved_and_feedback
checks.description: 'closed' only after 'resolved'; feedback exists iff the ticket currently is resolved/closed

checks.name: escalation_consistency
checks.description: Every 'escalated' event has a matching 'escalation' assignment (same instant) and vice versa; escalate at most once

checks.name: assignment_actors_valid
checks.description: Assigned staff belong to the team, hold a handling role and are active (with a 45-day horizon)

checks.name: single_open_assignment
checks.description: At most one open assignment per ticket and none after 'closed'

checks.name: requester_roles_can_raise
checks.description: Ticket requesters hold a role that may raise tickets

checks.name: staff_message_authors_assigned
checks.description: Staff authors of public/internal messages belong to a team that held the ticket at that time

checks.name: sla_status_reconciles
checks.description: first_response_status / resolution_status recomputed from stored due, response / resolution times and the as-of date

checks.name: sla_hours_reconcile
checks.description: first_response_business_hours / resolution_business_hours = business hours between created_at and the event

checks.name: sla_sources_reconcile
checks.description: sla.first_response_at = first public staff response; sla.resolved_at = feedback.resolved_at; sla.priority = ticket.priority

checks.name: feedback_derived_fields
checks.description: resolution_calendar/business hours and reopen_count recomputed from events; resolution_code equals the last 'resolved' event

checks.name: priority_follows_rule
checks.description: ticket.priority = derive_priority(category default, deadline, urgency words)

checks.name: routing_follows_rule
checks.description: Triage decision (category, ambiguity) = classify(subject + body); initial team = routing rule of the category (unless staff override)

checks.name: citation_version_recorded
checks.description: message_article_link.cited_version_no = article.version_no; links only on public staff 'answer' messages

checks.name: volume_totals
checks.description: Every ticket has >= 1 message (the request) and exactly one SLA row

checks.name: duplicate_tickets
checks.description: No two tickets share (requester, subject, body, created_at)

checks.name: duplicate_articles
checks.description: No two article versions of a topic share the same key fact value consecutively unless intended; no duplicate (topic, version)

checks.name: duplicate_messages
checks.description: No duplicate (ticket, sender, type, created_at, body)

checks.name: ticket_ids_contiguous
checks.description: TKT-2026-000001..N has no gaps; KB-000001..N has no gaps; REQ / STF contiguous

checks.name: policy_ids_follow_convention
checks.description: POL-<domain>-2026-NNN with the domain matching the policy domain and gap-free counters per domain

checks.name: ground_truth_not_in_input_tables
checks.description: No input column carries ground-truth labels (issue_type, expected_*, true_*, scenario, kind, is_ambiguous ...)

checks.name: ground_truth_is_separate_and_joinable
checks.description: ground_truth.csv lives in its own folder and every ticket_id joins to ticket (1:1)

checks.name: loads_into_sqlite_with_constraints
checks.description: CSV loads into SQLite with PRIMARY KEY / FOREIGN KEY / CHECK constraints enforced
